evidence: Walked all 2 gate + 16 functional + 6 polish + 4 visual criteria against the frozen golden. Every quoted seeded figure is reachable: seed clock 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z; K-10 'Boundary note' at 05-05T11:00:00Z is erased by sweep() because server.js:143 uses CLOCK_MS - at >= limit, while K-11 one second younger survives; K-13 probate (05-04, versions ['...2,400...']) and K-18 'Costs estimate' (05-03) are erased on a 7-day change because sweep measures from stored `at` and PATCH (server.js:438-441) never changes `at`; held K-7 survives (hold=0 filter, server.js:142); /api/messages/:id/versions returns 404 for deleted (server.js:372); K-17 'Insurer letter' release re-sweeps in the hold transaction (server.js:463); K-2 held+edited shows both versions in the transcript (server.js:510-512) with 'Landlords notice recieved.'; transcript heading 'M-11 · Pryce lease dispute' + 'Generated 2026-05-12 11:00 UTC' and K-3 sent time 2026-05-08 15:00 UTC (server.js:495,515,517), no chat controls. Walls/scope: visibleMatter gates every matter/message/search/mentions/preview/people/transcript route and returns plain 'Not available.' (server.js:194-201,232,335,343,505); a reply's parent must be in the URL matter (server.js:407) so JUDGE-W2/W3 cross-matter replays are refused before the idempotency check; walled Sian's replay of the wall-lift is 404 and non-partners get 403 on timer/hold/wall (server.js:461,471,483); author checks precede the stale-version check so Sian's hijack fails on authorship (server.js:432-435); mentions are recomputed on edit and cleared on delete, with case-insensitive first-name matching and canSee filtering (server.js:209-221,153); @ suggestions use /people filtered by canSee (M-12: Sian, Paul; M-11: Dev, Sian, Gwen). Search is literal String.includes on lowercased current body (server.js:385-388) so %, _, * and 'urvey booked' behave as required. Idempotent client_key (server.js:403,413-415) and seq ordering cover sent_once; tree walk in seq order (server.js:253-279) gives JUDGE-R1B after R1's branch and placeholders for deleted parents with live replies. Client: escape-first formatter (app.js:23-55) yields bold/code/blockquote/https links target=_blank and literal img/script/javascript:; 2 s polling (app.js:640-650) handles live updates, live walls (showUnavailable) and cross-tab unread; scrollTop and composer draft preserved (app.js:229-233); new-messages line from last_read and mark-unread (app.js:187,516-523; server.js:351-354 counts exclude own and deleted); Enter/Shift+Enter/Escape (app.js:411-421); in-page delete confirm; persistent .focused highlight (app.js:297, styles.css .message.focused); sign-in error stays in the form until input (app.js:89,95); transcript wraps at 390 (transcript.css max-width/overflow-wrap). Runtime: scripted golden on these exact source hashes (raw-evidence-index verified) reports PASS for gate_constraints, all 16 functional criteria, persistence before/after a real kill/restart, and all 6 polish criteria (qc/repairs/kittle-2026-10-08/results/golden-run.log). Hosted Oracle on PREVIOUS v2 bytes scored functional 1.0, polish 1.0, visual 0.9583 (phone_chambers 0.75, reportedly fixed in v3). Adversarial: a broken app that stored seeded `at` and swept against Date.now() or by edit time would fail timer_changes; the golden does neither. A conforming alternative that dedupes by a client key and is replayed with a changed URL but same key would return the old id (200) — criterion wall_every_route leg 5 still accepts 'appears nowhere'; the golden refuses earlier on parent-matter mismatch. No criterion found that the reference cannot pass. Risk=true only because required measurement is missing for these bytes: no full configured judge (claude-code/glm) run, Oracle grade or visual/render scoring exists for the v3 candidate; scripted Playwright PASS is not a judge PASS and v3's added legs/polish rows are unjudged.
